task_decomposition: Planner: map each claim to the frozen evidence record and allowed/forbidden claim boundaries before classification.
Critic: independently check whether each proposed classification is directly supported, unsupported, or forbidden by the stated evidence.

Recovery: revise any overbroad or ambiguous wording, especially claims implying production deployment, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.
Verifier: perform a final consistency check against the frozen evidence counts, Stage D-real variants/profiles/results, and the allowed versus forbidden claim lists.
success_criteria: C1 is treated as supported by the frozen count of 156 local artifact runs before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension.
C2 is treated as supported by Stage D-real: 120 executions over full-l4, oracle-only, and no-ipfs.
C3 is rejected as a forbidden production O-RAN deployment readiness claim.
C4 is rejected as a forbidden 240-run six-variant ablation claim.
C5 is treated as supported only in the bounded sense of inter-model claim-boundary checking or communication around local evidence.
C6 is rejected as a forbidden packet-capture network-impairment benchmark claim.

No claim is expanded beyond local workflow repeatability, local evidence-grounded model/tool orchestration, executable baseline comparison, profile-labelled orchestration robustness, and inter-model claim-boundary checking.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The frozen evidence supports local, evidence-grounded n8n workflow evaluation, including 156 pre-extension local artifact runs and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants, with Stage F/F focused on inter-model claim-boundary checking around the local artifact.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results constitute a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The evidence validates a public-chain benchmark or full media-plane QoE behavior.
The Stage F/F workflow proves model performance beyond bounded inter-model claim-boundary checking around local evidence.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Critic agent: classify C1-C6 strictly against the frozen evidence and allowed/forbidden claims, flag any overclaim, and preserve the local-only scope of the artifact.
